propositions.canonicalWording: A recursively expanding industrial system is conceptually possible.
propositions.currentStatus: A respectable conceptual case is made; no demonstrated closure is required.

propositions.canonicalWording: A recursively expanding industrial system might eventually be technically feasible.
propositions.currentStatus: Quantitatively explored across named assumption sets; complete-system feasibility is not demonstrated.

propositions.canonicalWording: Orbital and lunar compute during the Earth-dependent bridge would be economically competitive.
propositions.currentStatus: Quantified and negative at anchored values; crossover requires a specific, currently unanchored parameter corner.

propositions.canonicalWording: A mature, high-physical-closure space-industrial ecology would eventually obtain a structural economic advantage over terrestrial expansion.
propositions.currentStatus: Scenario-modeled but unresolved; neither tested space case becomes self-financing inside 40 years under the declared assumptions.

propositions.canonicalWording: The companies are deliberately integrating launch, communications, AI, compute, chip manufacture, and prospective off-world energy and manufacturing.
propositions.currentStatus: The portfolio direction is documented; shared technical interfaces, binding milestones, and joint resource allocation are not publicly established.

propositions.canonicalWording: The integrated portfolio is intended to produce recursive industrial closure.
propositions.currentStatus: Inferential; no closure program, seed bill of materials, reproduction metric, or minimum-cut roadmap is published.
